name: Ebook & SM-2 Vocabulary Studio
author: OmniDesk
description: Local EPUB/TXT/PDF-companion and Calibre-backed Kindle, FictionBook, office and comic reader, term etymology & sentence breakdown, and SM-2 spaced-repetition vocabulary studio.

config_schema.label: 电子书库目录
config_schema.description: User-configured ebook root directories (comma, newline, or pathsep separated, or JSON array string). No hardcoded paths.

config_schema.label: Calibre ebook-convert 路径
config_schema.description: Executable name or path to Calibre ebook-convert for Kindle, FB2, RTF, HTML, DOCX, ODT, comics and other Calibre input formats.

config_schema.label: 目标译文语言
config_schema.description: Target language code for bilingual blocks, term lookup, and sentence breakdown.

config_schema.label: 启用跨设备进度与生词同步
config_schema.description: Invoke optional book.sync.v1 when available to sync reading progress and vocabulary cards.

config_schema.label: 每日 SM-2 复习上限
config_schema.description: Default daily limit displayed in the SM-2 review queue.

config_schema.label: 查词自动联动台词切片
config_schema.description: Query optional media.clip_jump.v1 during term lookup when available.

config_schema.label: 分页字符预算
config_schema.description: Approximate character budget per paginated BookSpread page.
